faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TRAI Senior Associate Consultant Grade-I (AI/ML) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the TRAI Senior Associate Consultant Grade-I (AI/ML) recruitment is 24th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Tech/B.E. in relevant fields, MCA, M.Tech, or M.Sc. in Statistics. Proficiency in programming languages like Python, R, SQL, Scala, and Julia is also essential, along with 4+ years of experience in AI/ML.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Associate Consultant Grade-I (AI/ML) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Associate Consultant Grade-I (AI/ML) post is 35 years. Specific age relaxation details for reserved categories are usually mentioned in the official notification.

faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 1,20,000/- per month, along with a fixed Transport Allowance of Rs. 8,000/- per month, totaling Rs. 1,28,000/- per month.
